title: 爬遍中国五岳，他却说黄山之后无岳可看 | Huangshan Ended His Search 🏔️
description:
云海和日出，你会先追哪一个？评论区告诉我。

明代大旅行家徐霞客爬遍五岳，却留下一句「五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳」。让他封山的，是黄山——88 座千米以上的高峰挤成一片，云在脚下翻涌成海，松树从石缝里直直长出来。那棵迎客松，已经在崖上等了上千年；天一亮，云海被日出染成金色。奇松、怪石、云海、温泉，黄山的「四绝」，一次看个够。

Ming-dynasty traveler Xu Xiake climbed all Five Great Mountains, then said the search was over — because of Huangshan. It packs 88 peaks above 1,000 meters, a sea of clouds that rolls below your feet, and pines that grow straight out of bare rock. The famous "Greeting Pine" has stood on its cliff for a thousand years, and at dawn the cloud-sea turns gold. Strange pines, odd rocks, seas of cloud, hot springs — Huangshan's "Four Wonders," all at once.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
